summary: Galileo currently exports the application's OTel GenAI spans; validated target-product evidence now requires the owner to choose between retaining that path and replacing it with splunk-ao for dedicated Agent Stream routing.

evidence.finding: FastAPI, Galileo, and OpenTelemetry SDK dependencies
GalileoSpanProcessor plus app-owned workflow, chat, and tool spans
Galileo project and log stream are configured before uvicorn starts
A later validated compatibility check established two mutually exclusive supported export owners for the requested dedicated Agent Stream

signal_flow.component_flow_map:
FastAPI stream [SOURCE-COVERED] -> Galileo processor [GAP: Canonical GenAI export owner] -> support_turn [GAP: Streaming lifecycle telemetry]
Replacement branch -> splunk-ao [GAP: Splunk AO owner migration]

genai_readiness.required_signals: gen_ai.client.operation.time_to_first_chunk, gen_ai.client.operation.time_per_output_chunk, bounded chunk count, finish/close reason, cancellation, timeout, disconnect, and send/write failure while preserving one workflow/chat/tool span source
genai_readiness.acceptance_criteria: A completed, cancelled, timed-out, disconnected, and failed-write stream produces bounded lifecycle telemetry without duplicate invoke_workflow, chat, or execute_tool spans.
genai_readiness.impact: Operators cannot distinguish slow-first-token, partial, cancelled, timed-out, disconnected, or failed-write streams.

findings.title: Choose the canonical GenAI export owner
findings.gap: Validated target-product evidence establishes two supported but mutually exclusive runtime export owners; enabling both would duplicate the same logical GenAI operations.
findings.impact: Without one selected owner, instrumentation can duplicate traces or silently route them through the wrong project and Agent Stream.
findings.product_outcome: The application has one explicit canonical GenAI export owner before any branch-specific change is made.
findings.required_fix: The AI platform owner must select whether Galileo remains canonical or is replaced by splunk-ao.
findings.decision_question: Which supported runtime path should be the sole owner of GenAI span export and project/Agent Stream routing?

decision_options.label: Keep Galileo
decision_options.outcome: Retain Galileo and add only non-overlapping application-owned OTel lifecycle telemetry.

decision_options.label: Use splunk-ao
decision_options.outcome: Disable overlapping Galileo ownership and configure splunk-ao as the sole direct Agent Observability path.

acceptance_criteria: Exactly one supported GenAI export owner is recorded and only its executable branch can enter selection.
constraints: Do not enable Galileo and splunk-ao as overlapping owners for the same logical operations.
follow_up_actions: Record one owner choice before selecting branch-specific instrumentation.

findings.title: Keep Galileo and complete streaming lifecycle telemetry
findings.gap: The Galileo-exported app spans lack detector-ready first-chunk, chunk-cadence, terminal outcome, cancellation, timeout, disconnect, and failed-write signals.
findings.impact: Slow and partial streams cannot be detected or localized while Galileo remains the exporter.
findings.product_outcome: The existing Galileo path carries complete bounded streaming lifecycle telemetry without duplicate GenAI nodes.
findings.required_fix: Preserve Galileo and add the missing official OTel streaming metrics and bounded lifecycle events at the application stream boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Completed, cancelled, timed-out, disconnected, and failed-write streams emit the required metrics and terminal attributes through Galileo.
A representative trace contains exactly one support_turn workflow, one gpt-4o-mini chat call, and one search_docs tool call.
constraints: Do not install splunk-ao or edit installed Galileo package files.
Do not add duplicate workflow, chat, or tool spans.
follow_up_actions: Verify the lifecycle metrics and selected-trace terminal fields through the retained Galileo path.

findings.title: Replace Galileo with splunk-ao for dedicated routing
findings.gap: The selected replacement branch requires splunk-ao to become the sole GenAI exporter and to persist direct project and Agent Stream routing.
findings.impact: Leaving Galileo active would duplicate logical operations, while incomplete routing would leave traces unassigned or in the wrong stream.
findings.product_outcome: A fresh application trace reaches the intended project and Agent Stream through splunk-ao with required fields and no duplicate nodes.
findings.required_fix: Disable the overlapping Galileo processor and startup ownership, add splunk-ao through supported application/deployment configuration, and persist operator-overridable project and Agent Stream routing.
acceptance_criteria: The Galileo processor is not active in the selected runtime.
A fresh application trace appears in the intended project and Agent Stream with workflow, model, tool, token, timing, and terminal lifecycle fields.
The representative trace contains one node per logical workflow, chat call, and tool call.
constraints: Keep credentials in operator-owned secret storage and commit only placeholders or secret references.
Do not patch installed Galileo or splunk-ao packages.

expected_telemetry.name: agent-observability.splunk-ao-routing
expected_telemetry.product_view: Dedicated project and Agent Stream routing

follow_up_actions: Inspect a fresh routed trace and confirm required Agent Observability fields and duplicate-free topology.

environments.prerequisites: installed project dependencies and target-product credentials for live routing proof

scenarios.trigger: Resolve the canonical exporter decision before implementation
scenarios.acceptance_criteria: Only the executable branch unlocked by the recorded owner choice enters selection.

scenarios.trigger: Exercise completed, cancelled, timed-out, disconnected, and failed-write POST /v1/chat/stream requests
scenarios.expected_signals: streaming timing metrics and bounded terminal events exported by the retained Galileo path
scenarios.acceptance_criteria: The required lifecycle signals appear and one canonical workflow/chat/tool topology remains.

scenarios.trigger: Run a fresh POST /v1/chat/stream after selecting the splunk-ao replacement branch
scenarios.expected_signals: fresh duplicate-free trace in the configured project and Agent Stream with required workflow/model/tool/timing/terminal fields
scenarios.acceptance_criteria: The trace is routed to the intended project and Agent Stream, required fields populate, and Galileo emits no overlapping nodes.

anti_patterns: Running Galileo and splunk-ao as simultaneous owners for the same logical GenAI operations would duplicate traces.
recommendation: Record the exporter-owner decision, select only its unlocked executable finding, and run $otel-instrument.
